agent.nelcode_template:
# Instructions for the Nel Code agent

This file is added to the system message of every Agent mode request (its first 20,000 bytes).
Write here what the agent must know about this project.

## The project

- Language and version: (for example C# 12, .NET 8)
- What the program does:
- Important folders: (for example `src/` for the code, `tests/` for the tests)

## Rules

- Style: (naming conventions, indentation…)
- Always run the tests after a change: (for example `dotnet test`)
- Never change: (files or folders to leave as they are)

## Useful commands

- Build: `dotnet build`
- Test: `dotnet test`

rs.worker.no_files: files is empty: give the worker the files or folders it may write
rs.worker.out_of_scope: "{path}" is not assigned to this worker: it can only write {files}
rs.worker.overlap: denied: "{path}" is already assigned to worker {worker} ({scope}); a file is assigned to only one worker per request. Give other files, or ask {worker} for a correction with revise_worker
rs.worker.protected_scope: "{path}" is a protected file ({pattern}): a worker cannot write it. Do it yourself (the user confirms)
rs.worker.too_many_files: too many assigned files (at most {max}): give a folder instead
rs.worker.tool_not_allowed: the tool "{name}" is not allowed for a worker: it can only read (list_files, read_file, search) and write its files into its draft (write_file, edit_file); no command, MCP, plan, explorer or worker
rs.worker.unknown_after: after: no worker "{worker}" in this request (workers: {known})
set.about.label: About
set.accent.hint: The color of the main buttons, links and markers.
set.accent.label: Accent color
set.agentMaxTurns.hint: How many times the model may request tools (read, search, write) before it must answer.
set.agentMaxTurns.label: Max turns
set.allowedCommands.hint: One per line, for example "dotnet build" (also allows "dotnet build src/App.csproj"). Empty by default: every agent command asks Run / Deny. Never a shell (cmd, PowerShell…).
set.allowedCommands.label: Commands allowed without confirmation
set.autoUpdate.hint: At most once a day, on Nel Code's releases page (GitHub). Nothing is installed without your approval.
set.autoUpdate.label: Check for updates at startup
set.budgetConfirm.hint: At 100 % of the budget, ask for confirmation before each new paid request.
set.budgetConfirm.label: Confirm beyond the budget
set.budgetMonthly.hint: Paid providers only; 0: no budget. A warning at 80 %.
set.budgetMonthly.label: Monthly budget ($)
set.bug.hint: Version, system, active model and the last 50 log lines (never your conversations).
set.bug.label: Bug report
set.claude-key.hint: Anthropic's "claude" tool installed on this PC, and your API key (never a sign-in to an account).
set.claude-key.label: claude tool and API key
set.claudeAllowedTools.hint: One per line, for example "Read" or "Bash(dotnet build *)". Empty: only reads inside the working folder go through.
set.claudeAllowedTools.label: Tools allowed without approval (--allowedTools)
set.claudeModel.hint: An alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) or a full id (claude-opus-5-5). Empty: the tool's default model.
set.claudeModel.invalid: Letters, digits and "- . _ [ ]" only, 100 at most.
set.claudeModel.label: Model (--model)
set.claudePermissionMode.hint: What claude may do without asking you.
set.claudePermissionMode.label: Permission mode
set.claudePermissionMode.opt.default: Nothing automatic (default): anything that needs approval is denied
set.claudeProjectSettings.hint: Off by default: only your settings (~/.claude/settings.json) count. A project's settings can run commands (hooks), allow Bash without approval or send your key elsewhere: only turn this on for trusted projects.
set.claudeProjectSettings.label: Read project settings (.claude/settings.json)
set.commandTimeout.hint: Beyond this, the command and all its processes are stopped (120 s by default).
set.commandTimeout.label: Max duration of a command (s)
set.contextLimit.hint: At most this many conversation tokens (the model may handle more, but memory and response time rise fast). .nelmodel files keep their size. The loaded GGUF model is reloaded.
set.contextLimit.label: Context of GGUF models
set.defaultModel.hint: The model loaded when Nel Code starts. By default, the last one used; if it no longer exists, the last one used is taken.
set.defaultModel.label: Default model
set.density.hint: The space between messages, lists and buttons.
set.density.label: Density
set.device.hint: Where this PC's models run. The loaded model is reloaded.
set.device.label: Compute
set.explorerConcurrency.hint: The agent can start explorers that read the project for it (2 by default: many servers, like Ollama, handle requests one after another).
set.explorerConcurrency.label: Explorers at the same time
set.explorerMax.hint: At most this many explorers per request (5 by default; 0: no explorers).
set.explorerMax.label: Explorers per request
set.explorerModel.hint: A lighter model reads faster and costs less; it must support tools. If it no longer exists, the agent's model is used.
set.explorerModel.label: Explorer model
set.explorerTurns.hint: How many times an explorer may read or search before returning its summary (6 by default).
set.explorerTurns.label: Turns per explorer
set.export.hint: A JSON file with your preferences, never a key or secret, nor your providers or projects. When importing, you see what changes before confirming.
set.export.label: Export or import settings
set.gpu.hint: The detected NVIDIA card, the CUDA pack downloaded on demand, and the speed test.
set.gpu.keywords: nvidia cuda driver pack speed benchmark
set.gpu.label: Graphics card and GPU pack
set.imageMaxSide.hint: Before sending, each image is resized to this size (1568 by default, what Claude models read without shrinking it further) and re-encoded without its metadata (EXIF, GPS location…).
set.imageMaxSide.label: Longest side (px)
set.language.hint: The interface language, applied right away. Automatic: the system's language (English if it is neither French nor English).
set.language.label: Language
set.log.hint: One file per day, 7 days kept: events only, never the text of your conversations.
set.log.label: Log
set.markdown.hint: Headings, lists, tables, code… Off: the raw text, as the model wrote it. "Copy" always copies the original Markdown.
set.markdown.label: Format responses (Markdown)
set.maxReplyTokens.hint: Maximum length of a .nelmodel response, in tokens (about 3 characters each). A GGUF model writes up to 1024 tokens and stops on its own.
set.maxReplyTokens.label: Max length
set.mcp-servers.hint: Stdio or Streamable HTTP, for Agent mode: state, tools, log, Restart, Test, add, import from Claude Desktop. A conversation's servers are chosen with the MCP chip.
set.mcp-servers.label: MCP servers
set.mcpCallTimeout.hint: Beyond this, the call is canceled and the agent gets an error (60 s by default).
set.mcpCallTimeout.label: Max duration of a tool call (s)
set.mcpStartTimeout.hint: Launch, handshake and tool list (30 s by default).
set.mcpStartTimeout.label: Server startup at most (s)
set.prices.hint: Model, input, output, in $: one line per model. Used for estimated costs.
set.prices.label: Price per million tokens
set.protectedFiles.hint: One pattern per line (* and ?, "folder/" for a folder). Agent mode and @ files only read or browse them after your confirmation. Always protected: .env, .env.*, .git/, *.pem, *.key, *.pfx, id_rsa, *.kdbx, appsettings.*.json, secrets.json.
set.protectedFiles.label: Protected files
set.providers.hint: OpenAI-compatible servers and the Claude API: address, key, test, models and images.
set.providers.keywords: ollama llama.cpp lm studio openai anthropic key qwen vision images
set.providers.label: Providers (remote models)
set.repetitionPenalty.hint: Makes the last 64 tokens (prompt included) less likely, so the model does not loop. 1 = off; too high, it avoids even useful words.
set.repetitionPenalty.label: Repetition penalty
set.server-key.hint: Authorization: Bearer <key>. One response at a time, shared with Nel Code. Connecting Continue: see the README.
set.server-key.label: Address and access key
set.serverEnabled.hint: For Continue in VS Code, or any OpenAI API client. Only on this PC (127.0.0.1), and only with the key below.
set.serverEnabled.label: Enable the server (OpenAI API)
set.serverPort.label: Port
set.summaryThreshold.hint: When the conversation exceeds this share of the model's context (remote or GGUF), older exchanges are summarized by the active model; the last 4 stay as they are. 0: never (/compact summarizes by hand).
set.summaryThreshold.label: Automatic summary at (% of context)
set.temperature.hint: Low: careful, repetitive answers. High: more creative, more mistakes.
set.temperature.label: Temperature
set.textSize.hint: The whole interface grows or shrinks: Ctrl + and Ctrl − in 10 % steps, Ctrl 0 for 100 %.
set.textSize.label: Zoom (%)
set.theme.hint: The colors of the whole interface (shared with Nel Code C#).
set.theme.label: Theme
set.topK.hint: Sample among the K most likely tokens (0 = no limit).
set.topK.label: Top-k
set.topP.hint: Sample among the tokens that make up this share of the probability (1 = no limit).
set.topP.label: Top-p
set.update-now.hint: Checks right away whether a new version exists.
set.update-now.label: Check now
set.usage-page.hint: Tokens, estimated costs and response times, by day, model and project; CSV export.
set.usage-page.label: Usage page
set.vision.hint: Detected automatically (Claude, Ollama, llama.cpp) or set by hand, model by model, in Providers → Images.
set.vision.label: Models that see images
set.workerConcurrency.hint: The agent can start workers that each write their own files into a draft, which you review at the end (2 by default).
set.workerConcurrency.label: Workers at the same time
set.workerMax.hint: At most this many workers per request (4 by default; 0: no workers).
set.workerMax.label: Workers per request
set.workerModel.hint: It must support tools. If it no longer exists, the agent's model is used.
set.workerModel.label: Worker model
set.workerTurns.hint: How many times a worker may read or write before returning its summary (10 by default; a correction gives as many again).
set.workerTurns.label: Turns per worker
